mentions.name: Options Trading Game
mentions.description: A browser-based options trading game that helps players learn about stock options by letting them practice trading strategies in a game format.
mentions.problem: The author understood the basics of stock options but didn't really 'get' them, despite a retired financial planner friend explaining how options could be leveraged to reduce portfolio risk, so a game was built as a better way to understand them.
mentions.audience: People learning about stock options, notably the author who wanted to better understand how options can be used, such as to reduce portfolio risk.
